encounters.title: First accidental look — office equipment handover

beats.name: Return for the pending signature
beats.plot: Rohit returns with the corrected Jan 1 asset-acknowledgment sheet, remembering Ankita's playful Rohit Babu nickname. He is focused on actually completing his office responsibility, not engineered flirtation; Ankita knows him as a helpful junior colleague.

beats.name: Short practical banter and reassurance
beats.plot: Ankita jokes about his neatly updated equipment records, reminds him that accurate signatures matter, and asks about his holiday duty. Rohit is more comfortable responding after yesterday's introduction. Establish their warmth and power difference without inventing years of personal history.

beats.name: One small missing accessory — reason to move and return
beats.plot: One AV cable cap / adapter insert is missing from the kit. Rohit steps out to retrieve it, promising a quick return; the discrepancy is concrete and prevents the first encounter from occurring purely because a woman is walking by.

beats.name: Accidental outfit trigger
beats.plot: While sorting documents and setting the office kit on a low cabinet, Ankita puts her light dupatta/scarf aside so it does not catch. Rohit comes back with the missing part. She naturally bends to lift a small item and pass it to him. The angle briefly reveals more of her neckline than either expected; she does not notice until afterward. No purposeful posing yet.

beats.name: Rohit's unexpected quietness
beats.plot: Rohit's eyes catch the changed neckline for an instant. His expression and broken sentence are notably different from his usual easy politeness. Ankita first thinks he is distracted or worried about the handover. No physical contact and no imagined spoken confession.

beats.name: A quiet courtesy and hurried exit
beats.plot: Ankita offers a glass of water or tea as an ordinary courtesy; Rohit politely hesitates and then abruptly leaves, claiming to be needed elsewhere. In his disorientation, he forgets the signed acknowledgment he came to collect. This explicitly adapts Dhika EP04's forgotten payment without a grocery plot.

beats.name: Ankita's afterthought / deferred question
beats.plot: She discovers the signed form still on the desk, calls after him too late, then thinks back to his surprising pause. She checks her dupatta and the way her neckline had fallen, wondering whether he saw anything. This is uncertainty, not an instant declared romance. His office responsibilities give him a believable reason to return later TODAY.

encounters.title: Same-day follow-up — the first deliberate show

beats.name: Later-day return for the missing acknowledgment
beats.plot: Rohit returns the same afternoon for the signed slip. He tries to be extra businesslike, avoiding the awkwardness he cannot explain. Ankita recognizes he is behaving differently and gently draws him into ordinary conversation.

beats.name: Colleague-to-colleague care before flirtation
beats.plot: Instead of sending him away, Ankita invites him to sit during a lunch/tea break and share snacks or a canteen meal. Like Dhika's kindness to Chotu, this scene shows her treating a junior worker as a person, not just staff. Explore his support work and personal goals conversationally; any specific family hardships require separate confirmation.

beats.name: Longer dialogue establishes sincerity
beats.plot: Rohit helps clear the cups and work items rather than simply leaving. Ankita teases his hurry and the forgotten form. His nervousness eases; he shows that he is attentive and proud of his work. Keep their dialogue and individual motivations present, not a compressed summary.

beats.name: First genuine appearance compliment
beats.plot: With her light layer/scarf momentarily off during the break, Rohit notices the less formal version of her outfit and sincerely says it suits her and that she looks very beautiful today. This is his first unprompted appearance compliment, unlike Bhalla and Sandeep's practiced banter. Ankita did not ask for it and privately notes its sincerity.

beats.name: Mirror and morning-to-afternoon inner comparison
beats.plot: Ankita has a private mirror pause in a washroom or changing area. She recalls Priya/Nisha's Jan 1 figure jokes, Bhalla/Sandeep's confident attention, her unresolved personal attractiveness question, Rohit's first stunned reaction earlier today, and his newly sincere compliment. She asks whether Rohit noticed something real or merely glanced by chance. This is a character-specific continuation, not Dhika's first-ever self-awareness.

beats.name: Intentional attention test begins
beats.plot: Ankita now chooses a deliberate second look: she leaves her dupatta/scarf aside, returns to the office space where Rohit can see her, casually resumes sorting a small office item near a lower cabinet, and maintains a confidently playful posture. The goal is to see whether the earlier surprise recurs. She consciously controls the situation; don't label this accidental again.

beats.name: Reaction, extended eye contact, no premature conclusions
beats.plot: Rohit notices her new presentation and becomes quiet. Ankita finally meets his gaze instead of only wondering what he saw. An awkward, charged silence makes the contrast between his shy sincerity and Bhalla/Sandeep's bold double meanings clear. Rohit then collects the signed slip and leaves with an unusually quick goodbye. Keep his inner and her external reactions distinguishable; don't invent a physical encounter or an explicit proposition.

beats.name: Private afterbeat and future-seed
beats.plot: Alone afterward, Ankita is unexpectedly exhilarated and self-conscious about deliberately testing his attention. She knows what she chose to do but is still unsure how Rohit interpreted it. This completes her two-stage same-day First Show while keeping trust, curiosity and the next encounter unresolved; no further visual test is invented this episode.
